internal_request.subject: New shipper boxes and inner packaging for both plants
internal_request.body:
Hi Pavan,

We launch the new home-care line next quarter and need new shipper boxes and inner packaging at both plants.

Roughly: large and medium 5-ply shippers for the 5 L and 2 L packs, small 3-ply cartons for the sachet bundles, a heavy-duty 7-ply box for the export pallets, plus die-cut trays, partitions and layer pads.

Plant 1 (Pune) will run about 60% of the volume and Plant 2 (Nashik) about 40%. Annual volumes per item are in the attached sheet.

Quality asked for two things: every supplier must have a valid ISO 9001 certificate, and BCT test reports for the 5- and 7-ply boxes. Finance wants 60-day payment terms, in line with our other packaging contracts.

Can we have suppliers in place before the end of next month?

Thanks,
Anita

vendors.name: Kaveri Corrugators
vendors.rfi_note: Within 200 km of both plants; 7-ply capable
vendors.rfp_summary: Supplies both plants by road from one unit near Pune, with next-day delivery to Plant 1 and two-day delivery to Plant 2. In-house BCT and ECT lab with a test report for every batch. Holds one week of buffer stock for the top ten items.

vendors.name: Deccan Boxboard Exports
vendors.rfi_note: Largest capacity; export unit, quotes in USD
vendors.rfp_summary: Export-oriented unit with the largest capacity on the shortlist. Prices in USD because of its export licence. Offers volume tiers on high-runner items and a dedicated account manager. Quality testing is outsourced to an accredited lab.

vendors.name: Shakti Pack Works
vendors.rfi_note: Low prices last year; smaller capacity
vendors.rfp_summary: Smaller family-run unit, 140 km from Plant 1, with the lowest prices in last year's spot buys. Can supply both plants but would need two weeks' notice for volume spikes. BCT testing available on request through a partner lab.

vendors.name: Narmada Cartons
vendors.rfi_note: Next to Plant 2; current inner-packaging supplier
vendors.rfp_summary: Located next to Plant 2 and already supplies its inner packaging (trays and partitions). Proposes a vendor-managed stock point inside Plant 2. Prices by weight (per kg), as it does for current orders.

vendors.name: Sahyadri Paperpack
vendors.rfp_summary: Current shipper-box supplier to both plants under contract #2025-V5. Proposes to continue on last year's terms with small price changes, and to add the new items. Strong on-time delivery record over the last 12 months.
